title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Communication
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The continuous process of transmitting information, ideas, and messages from a sender to a receiver with the assurance of mutual understanding is called
questions.explain: **Communication** is the essential aid to trade that bridges the gap of knowledge and information between producers, distributors, and consumers.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Why is effective communication highly important in a business organization?
options: It physically transports bulky goods across the ocean.
It facilitates quick decision-making and links buyers directly with suppliers.
It prevents physical fires from destroying the warehouse.
It single-handedly changes raw materials into finished goods.
questions.explain: Communication ensures a smooth flow of information, enabling **quick decision-making** and helping businesses maintain constant contact with customers and suppliers.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which means of communication provides the fastest oral interaction and immediate feedback between a businessman in Lagos and a supplier in Abuja?
questions.explain: The **telephone** allows for instantaneous two-way voice communication, ensuring immediate discussions, clarifications, and feedback regardless of physical distance.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Before the widespread use of the internet, which traditional agency was primarily responsible for transmitting written letters, telegrams, and small parcels nationwide?
questions.explain: **The Postal Service** (such as NIPOST in Nigeria) was traditionally the primary government agency established to handle mail, registered letters, telegraphs, and parcels.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An electronic system of communication that interconnects global computer networks, allowing businesses to send emails and operate websites, is known as the
questions.explain: The **World Wide Web (Internet)** is the global electronic network that has revolutionized communication through instant emails, video conferencing, and business websites.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Private communication and logistics agencies that specialize in the very fast, secure, and door-to-door delivery of highly important business documents are called
questions.explain: **Courier services** (like DHL or FedEx) provide premium, trackable, and expedited delivery of urgent documents and parcels directly to the receiver's address.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following specific services is typically provided by a Postal Agency rather than a Telephone Service Provider?
questions.explain: Postal agencies specialize in physical mail. **Registered mail and parcel post** are classical services offered by post offices to securely transport physical items.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a business owner uses the internet to launch an online marketing campaign targeted at millions of viewers, the World Wide Web is simultaneously acting as a means of communication and
questions.explain: The internet (WWW) is versatile. When used to promote a product to the public, it serves as both a communication tool and a powerful **advertising medium**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In the communication process, how does a sender confirm that the receiver has successfully received and correctly understood a business message?
options: Through the payment of an insurance premium
Through immediate feedback provided by the receiver
By depositing money in a commercial bank
By physically checking the supplier's warehouse
questions.explain: Communication is only complete when the receiver interprets the message and sends **feedback** (a response) back to the sender, confirming understanding.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Without an effective system of communication, a large business organization would most likely suffer from
options: a sudden influx of physical cash
poor internal coordination and a breakdown in daily operations
an oversupply of agricultural raw materials
questions.explain: Communication acts as the central nervous system of a business. Without it, instructions fail, departments cannot collaborate, and the result is **poor internal coordination and operational breakdown**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A company urgently needs to send a highly confidential, original legal contract to a partner in another city, requiring a guarantee of safe hand-delivery and a signature upon receipt. The best service to use is
questions.explain: Because the document is original, confidential, and requires proof of delivery (a signature), a private **courier service** is the most reliable, secure, and accountable method to use.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
